description: Expected results for the official DHSVM Chiwawa test case (DHSVM-PNNL repo TestCase/Chiwawa, config INPUT.Chiwawa.Baseline unchanged): Chiwawa River basin, WA, USA, 425 x 300 grid at 90 m (55046 active pixels), 3-hour step, 10/01/1970-00 to 10/01/1971-00 (the official period, one water year), Livneh gridded forcing, network flow routing. Checks: normal finish + Mass.Final.Balance terms + streamflow and snow numbers.

numeric_checks.name: end_of_model_run
numeric_checks.why: model's own end line 'END OF MODEL RUN' in stdout

numeric_checks.name: n_streamflow_steps
numeric_checks.why: 365 days x 8 three-hour steps in Streamflow.Only

numeric_checks.name: mb_mass_error_mm
numeric_checks.why: Mass.Final.Balance Mass Error: water balance closes to 0.036 mm over the year

numeric_checks.name: flow_mean_m3_per_step
numeric_checks.why: mean of Streamflow.Only (m3 per 3-h step) at the Chiwawa outlet

numeric_checks.name: swq_max_basin_mean_m
numeric_checks.why: peak basin-mean snow water equivalent (Swq column of Aggregated.Values)

numeric_checks.name: nan_inf_tokens_in_outputs
numeric_checks.why: no NaN/Inf values in any output file

recorded_with: /mnt/disk1/Hydrocraft_server/models/DHSVM/source/repo/build/DHSVM/sourcecode/DHSVM run through the KI tool tools/run_dhsvm.py on the unchanged official inputs (pack DHSVM/chiwawa_v1)
reference: The DHSVM repo ships no reference outputs for Chiwawa (the output/ folder is not tracked), so the numbers come from our own runs: two clean runs (one through the KI tool, one direct) gave byte-identical output files (Aggregated.Values, Mass.Balance, Mass.Final.Balance, Stream.Flow, Streamflow.Only, saturation_extent.txt).
notes: The official period is one water year and runs in about 2-3 minutes, so nothing was shortened. Mass.Final.Balance prints 3 decimals, so tol 0.002 mm there; Streamflow.Only prints 5 significant digits.
